evidence.description: Mutable instance state 'items' is declared as a Set.
The 'items' state is modified from a background thread (URLSession dataTask completion) via DispatchQueue.main.async.

candidates.explanation: The mutable instance state 'items' is accessed and modified from multiple concurrency contexts (the main queue and the background session completion) without actor isolation or synchronization.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation
